div.style: box-sizing: border-box; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); grid-template-rows: [label] minmax(16px, max-content) [value] 1fr [trend] minmax(16px, max-content); height: 100%; justify-items: center; padding: 8px

span.style: -webkit-box-orient: vertical; -webkit-line-clamp: 1; color: var(--chartml-text-secondary, #6b7280); display: -webkit-box; font-size: 12px; grid-column: 1; grid-row: label; line-height: 16px; max-width: 100%; overflow: hidden; text-align: center
align-self: center; color: var(--chartml-text, #374151); font-size: 28px; font-weight: bold; grid-column: 1; grid-row: value; line-height: 32px; max-width: 100%; text-align: center
